pages.title: Ricochet Knight
pages.creator: Sidrick
pages.description: Launch a knight across rooms in Ricochet Knight by dragging to aim and releasing to dash. Bounce off surfaces and strike monsters before their attack counters reach zero. Collect gold for permanent upgrades and stars that unlock additional heroes.

pages.title: Crown & Conquest
pages.creator: Rick&Jean
pages.description: Capture rival cities in Crown & Conquest by sending troops between settlements. Choose how much of your force to commit while protecting territory you already own. Explore the campaign map, rally troops, and plan attacks around the positions of neighboring armies.

pages.title: Pyramid Solitaire
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Remove cards totaling thirteen in Pyramid Solitaire. Pair exposed cards, clear kings individually, and draw from the stock when you need another match. Work toward emptying the seven-row pyramid before the available cards leave you without a legal pair.

pages.title: Cute Farm Match Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Cute Farm Match Puzzle combines animal matching with rope-based physics. In Squish mode, tap animal blocks to release ropes and drop them onto other pieces. Use those impacts to complete the collection task, or choose the separate Catch mode.

pages.title: Ayla World Princess life
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Create a royal avatar in Ayla World Princess life. Choose clothing combinations and design nails to coordinate with the outfit. The game centers on experimenting with the available fashion and manicure choices to give your princess an individual appearance.

pages.title: Ping Pong Air
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Return shots with a mouse-controlled bat in Ping Pong Air. Progress through classic matches, climb the career tournament ladder, or tackle target and Halloween challenges. Earn trophies and crystal orbs as you work toward new bats and achievements.

pages.title: Word Search Universe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Locate six concealed words in each puzzle of Word Search Universe. Drag across the letter grid to highlight a word when you find it. Chapters offer different difficulty settings, and a hint button helps when another answer remains difficult to spot.

pages.title: Through the Wall 3D
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Adjust a character's pose to fit approaching openings in Through the Wall 3D. Match the required shape so the figure can pass through the wall. Each new opening asks you to judge the outline and arrange the character accordingly.

pages.title: Zombie Horde: Build & Survive
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Build a defense against advancing undead in Zombie Horde: Build & Survive. Place turrets, traps, and barricades, then use weapons to help hold the line. Move around the battlefield while trying to keep successive waves from overwhelming your position.

pages.title: Oil Digging
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Find and exploit an oil deposit in Oil Digging. Drill a well and construct a pipe network to support the operation. The simulation connects discovering oil with building an efficient extraction setup, making the cost and layout of your infrastructure matter.

pages.title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style characters for different occasions in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition. Combine makeup with outfits for events such as festivals, dates, holidays, and red-carpet appearances. Explore the themed fashion choices and create a complete look for each styling challenge.

pages.title: Tung Tung Sagur: Clicker
pages.creator: Maksim Popov
pages.description: Tap a meme character to generate resources in Tung Tung Sagur: Clicker. Earn coins through the game's meme-character economy and spend them on improvements. Repeated clicking and upgrades build the operation around its cast of internet-inspired figures.

pages.title: Push To Go
pages.creator: LaylayStudio Games
pages.description: Press movement buttons to navigate platform puzzles in Push To Go. Time your inputs around obstacles and collect stars as you work through each stage. Additional stages open through progression, giving you new arrangements to solve with the button-based movement system.

pages.title: Bow And Arrow
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Take aim at archery challenges in Bow And Arrow. Use the mouse to release shots toward the available targets, including moving marks and enemies. The levels focus on placing arrows accurately as the shooting situations change.

pages.title: Minicraft Winterblock
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Search a snowy forest in Minicraft Winterblock for two chests and the required snowballs. Jump on monsters to defeat them while navigating the level. Reach the hidden portal after completing the collection tasks to leave the area safely.

pages.title: Princesses at Horror School
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two monster students in Princesses at Horror School. Apply makeup, create colorful hairstyles, and combine tops, skirts, or dresses into Halloween looks. Their wardrobes blend royal fashion with monster details, and the completed result can be saved as an image.

pages.title: Hero Fight Clash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Choose a fighter and battle increasingly powerful opponents in Hero Fight Clash. Use the hero's skills during horizontal combat encounters and upgrade as the adventure continues. The game connects successive duels with developing the abilities of your selected character.

pages.title: Nesting Dolls
pages.creator: BOLD CAT
pages.description: Clear a board of matryoshkas in Nesting Dolls by moving them into the lower collection tier. Three dolls of one color disappear together. Plan the order of your selections, because filling every space in that tier ends the attempt.

pages.title: Doge Match
pages.creator: Myroslav Diiak
pages.description: Connect dogs of the same color in Doge Match to earn points. Longer chains produce larger scores, helping you reach each level's target. Finish within the time allowance to earn stars as you progress through the matching puzzles.

pages.title: Fighter Stick Hero
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fight stick-figure opponents in Fighter Stick Hero. Choose a weapon and customize your character before entering arcade or survival battles. Keep moving while attacking and defeat opponents to increase your score through the game's dueling encounters.

pages.title: Colors Runners
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather a same-colored group in Colors Runners and steer it toward the finish. Stay on routes matching your character's body color to avoid being shot. Slide to collect companions while keeping the crowd on a compatible path.

pages.title: Horde Hunters
pages.creator: Blacktabb Games
pages.description: Shoot zombies from a moving vehicle in Horde Hunters. Earn money from kills and reinvest it in faster firing and better income. Merge soldiers to improve your force as the idle shooting operation continues against the undead crowd.

pages.title: Sky Maze Challenge
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Navigate elevated obstacle courses in Sky Maze Challenge. Move and jump past traps, choosing each landing carefully to avoid a fatal misstep. Progress depends on precision across the route as you work to complete the maze-like course.

pages.title: Real World Soccer Cup Flicker 3D 2023
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Complete timed kicking tasks in Real World Soccer Cup Flicker 3D 2023. Hold the ball and swipe upward to take a shot. Different modes present football challenges built around directing your kicks and meeting the objective before time expires.

pages.title: Football - Soccer
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Take part in stadium matches in Football - Soccer. Move players, pass, accelerate, and shoot when your team has possession. When opponents control the ball, switch players and challenge for it as you try to build the next scoring opportunity.

pages.title: Auto Rickshaw Simulator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Carry passengers around a busy city in Auto Rickshaw Simulator. Follow the route arrow to pickup and drop-off points while navigating traffic under time constraints. Successful journeys earn money that can be spent improving your rickshaw.

pages.title: Tom's Adventure
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Help Tom rescue his kidnapped sister in Tom's Adventure. Travel through an alien-invasion platform campaign, using a second midair jump to handle difficult crossings. Guide him through the levels with keyboard or on-screen movement controls.

pages.title: VEX Challenges
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Race a countdown timer through obstacle stages in VEX Challenges. Reach the finish before time expires and try to collect all three stars along the way. New skins and a separate challenge mode add further goals beyond completing the timed courses.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Merge Master
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Combine matching dinosaurs and warriors in Dinosaurs Merge Master to strengthen your army. Arrange and merge units on the battlefield before confronting enemy forces. The challenge links quick decisions about your troops with the outcome of each fight.

pages.title: Yummy Pancake Factory
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Prepare breakfast in Yummy Pancake Factory. Mix batter, pour it into a pan, and cook pancakes until they are ready for decoration. Choose toppings for the finished stack, working through both the cooking steps and the final presentation.

pages.title: Clash of Trivia
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Answer general-knowledge questions against another player in Clash of Trivia. The quick-fire quiz supports matches with friends through invitation codes or with online opponents. Keep choosing answers as the contest tests how much you know across different subjects.

pages.title: Lethal Race
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description: Race aggressively over uneven courses in Lethal Race. Earn money, upgrade your vehicle, and attack rivals while trying to cross the finish first. Flips add another challenge to the driving as you balance stunts with surviving the race.

pages.title: Cute Kids Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Assemble cartoon vehicle pictures in Cute Kids Trucks Jigsaw. Select a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces and drag each section into position. The untimed format lets you study the shapes while rebuilding the truck illustration.

pages.title: Clash of Golf Friends
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Compete to finish a miniature-golf course in Clash of Golf Friends. Two or four players race through ten holes, aiming to complete the course ahead of their friends. Drag to line up each shot, then release to strike the ball.

pages.title: Cakes Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Link matching dessert tiles in Cakes Mahjong Connect. Each connection may turn no more than twice, so an identical pair is useful only when its route is clear. Remove all the cakes before the timer expires to finish the board.

pages.title: Fruit Bubble Shooters
pages.creator: Bizogames.com
pages.description: Aim colored fruit bubbles in Fruit Bubble Shooters and form groups of at least three identical ones. Clear the level while keeping the number of shots low. More efficient shooting helps you work toward a full set of stars.

pages.title: Castel Wars Middle Ages
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Battle with medieval equipment in Castel Wars Middle Ages. Build blocks, change weapons, and use cannons, arrows, or swords against opponents. Play alone or with a second player, and collect wing bonuses that slow your descent from above.

pages.title: Fire Balls 3D shooting
pages.creator: IzelgueGames
pages.description: Fire at stacked obstacles in Fire Balls 3D shooting. Keep shooting to destroy the tower sections while avoiding the rotating barriers around them. Watch the rings before each burst so your shots reach the targets without striking an obstruction.

pages.title: Volley Random
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Volley Random turns volleyball into a ragdoll contest with changing conditions. Use a single control for each player to keep returning the ball. Courts, players, and balls can change between rounds, so scoring depends on adapting to each new setup.

pages.title: Roof Rails
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Extend the pole carried by your runner in Roof Rails. Collect sticks so it becomes long enough to cross suspended gaps and other obstacles. Sections of the route, including magma, put that accumulated length to use as you move toward the end.

pages.title: Winter Moto
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride through wintry terrain in Winter Moto while collecting coins. Use your earnings to purchase motorcycles and improve their power and wheels. Keyboard controls handle the bike as you tackle another stretch of the snow-themed course.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring LOL
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color doll illustrations in Easy Kids Coloring LOL. Choose a picture and apply colors to its outlined areas, creating your own palette for the character. The game also offers ways to print or download pictures for coloring beyond the screen.

pages.title: Sea World Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Draw chains through matching ocean items in Sea World Collection. Join at least three neighboring pieces horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to collect them. Longer links provide bonuses, but each level's target items must be gathered before its timer expires.

pages.title: Lost My Chicken
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a wandering chicken in Lost My Chicken. Click left or right to change its path and avoid obstacles along the route. Keep the chicken moving through the scenery while collecting coins and trying to extend the run.

pages.title: Mutant Orc Invasion
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Defend a town from waves of orcs in Mutant Orc Invasion. Shoot arrows from the castle roof and call on a knight or catapult for support. React to each incoming group and eliminate the attackers before they overrun the defense.

pages.title: Wordmeister
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build words from letter tiles in Wordmeister. Place them on the board to earn points and use bonus spaces to increase letter or word values. Compete against the computer, working toward the higher total through stronger word placements.

pages.title: City Garbage truck
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Collect waste around town in City Garbage truck. Plan a route between buildings and retrieve their garbage containers before the timer expires. Steer the truck with keyboard controls, using the brake to manage the stops along your collection run.

pages.title: Jumping bottle
pages.creator: OcelotGames
pages.description: Keep a bottle moving past interfering hands in Jumping bottle. Click or tap to jump, watching how the hands change speed before choosing your moment. Continue the run to build a higher score and work toward the available achievements.

pages.title: Bridal Boutique Salon Wedding Planner Games
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Prepare several parts of a wedding in Bridal Boutique Salon Wedding Planner Games. Choose a bridal dress, apply makeup, decorate a cake, and give the groom a makeover. The game connects the couple's styling with preparations for their celebration.

pages.title: Cargo Truck Transport Simulator Game
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Transport goods over uphill routes in Cargo Truck Transport Simulator Game. Handle a long truck on narrow roads and uneven off-road sections while carrying its load. The driving challenge comes from guiding the cargo vehicle through difficult terrain.

pages.title: Control 3 Cars
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Manage three vehicles simultaneously in Control 3 Cars. Watch all three roads and steer the cars around obstacles as they appear. Your run lasts only as long as you can divide your attention successfully and keep the vehicles out of trouble.

pages.title: Jungal Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Search jungle pictures for concealed stars in Jungal Hidden Stars. Inspect the illustrated scenery and click each star you find. The challenge centers on picking small shapes out of the surrounding detail rather than rushing through the scene.

pages.title: Ambulances Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore emergency-vehicle pictures in Ambulances Slide. Move the scrambled image sections into their correct arrangement to reveal the ambulance. Three pictures and three modes offer different puzzles to work through as you rebuild each scene.

pages.title: Pandas Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Arrange scrambled picture sections in Pandas Slide to restore the original animal scene. Choose among three images and three modes before solving the layout. Compare the sections and move them into place until the panda picture is complete.

pages.title: Cars and Girls Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cars and Girls Puzzle pairs anime-style characters with vehicles in six jigsaw pictures. Choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, then rebuild the selected scene. The different piece counts let you adjust how much detail you need to sort.

pages.title: BTS Donkey Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Add your own colors to four animal pictures in BTS Donkey Coloring Book. Choose a donkey illustration and fill its outlined areas however you prefer. There is no time limit, so you can compare colors and work on the drawing at leisure.

pages.title: Cozy Bedroom Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find seven changes between bedroom pictures in Cozy Bedroom Difference. Each scene gives you one minute to finish comparing the pair. Work through ten levels, scanning the furnishings and other small details for the alterations that distinguish the images.

pages.title: Christmas Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rebuild holiday vehicle scenes in Christmas Truck Jigsaw. Choose a picture and a piece count, then fit the scattered sections back together. Five truck illustrations offer different Christmas puzzles to complete with your preferred level of complexity.

pages.title: Drive Taxi
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Collect passengers and carry them to their destinations in Drive Taxi. Click to start or stop the vehicle, timing its movement around traffic. Remember the pickup points while making sure another car does not turn the journey into a collision.

pages.title: Knock The Ball
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Demolish stacked structures in Knock The Ball. Throw balls at the target and use the impacts to bring pieces down or trigger explosions. Judge where a hit will do useful damage as you try to collapse more of the arrangement.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Throat Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat a throat infection in Dotted Girl Throat Doctor. Follow the illustrated care sequence, using a laser tool against germs and applying cream to swelling. The game centers on completing the patient's virtual treatment so she can recover.

pages.title: Gamellina Fashion Multiplication
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Solve multiplication questions to unlock fashion choices in Gamellina Fashion Multiplication. Complete the set of arithmetic problems, then enter dress-up mode and style Gamellina. A printable certificate records the math portion after you finish it.

pages.title: Crazy Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Create jewel chains in Crazy Match3. Connect three or more gems to collect points, looking for longer links when the layout allows them. The scoring challenge is to turn the available jewel arrangement into increasingly productive matching chains.

pages.title: Audi RS6 Avant Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reconstruct car photographs in Audi RS6 Avant Puzzle. Six images each offer four piece counts ranging from 16 to 100. Choose the difficulty you want, then arrange the sections until the selected vehicle picture is complete.

pages.title: Unicorn Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give Mia a colorful makeover in Unicorn Hairstyles. Choose one of three unicorn-inspired styles and work through the hairstyling activity. Experiment with the playful designs to create a finished look built around bright, fantasy-themed hair.

pages.title: Old Rusty Cars Differences 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare worn vehicle scenes in Old Rusty Cars Differences 3. Select the changes between the two pictures before time runs out. Faster completion earns a higher score, and a hint button offers help when one remaining alteration is hard to find.

pages.title: Wizard in a Bubble
pages.creator: Wavertron
pages.description: Guide a floating magician to the exit in Wizard in a Bubble. Click or touch to blow the bubble around hazards and toward the portal. Some puzzles require popping it, so decide when to use up the wizard's only bubble.

pages.title: Jungle Adventure
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Travel through a jungle adventure while freeing animals in Jungle Adventure. Break cages, gather stars, and use available upgrades or temporary helpers along the way. The game connects progress through the environment with rescuing its captive creatures.

pages.title: Master Archery
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Use a bow to free characters in Master Archery. Aim your arrows carefully while working within the supply provided for each level. Complete the rescues and try for a stronger score by making efficient use of your shots.

pages.title: Art Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reassemble famous artwork in Art Puzzle Challenge. Select an image and choose an easy, medium, or hard puzzle before fitting its pieces together. With no time limit, you can study the artwork's details while working toward the completed picture.

pages.title: Yellow Bird Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Tap to keep a bird airborne in Yellow Bird Adventure. Collect food for additional points while avoiding black birds and other obstacles. Continue flying as far as possible without falling or colliding with anything along the route.

pages.title: Mirror Dash Travel Odyssey
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Switch between mirrored courses in Mirror Dash Travel Odyssey. Jump over obstacles or teleport to the opposite environment when the current route becomes dangerous. Its two-control system makes timing the choice between a jump and a switch central to survival.

pages.title: Kitsune Power Destruction
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Help an angry fox spirit smash temple pillars in Kitsune Power Destruction. Keep destroying the structures while watching for armed guardians concealed within them. The task is to continue the destruction without being stopped by the protectors waiting inside.

pages.title: Parking Meister
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Maneuver into marked spaces in Parking Meister. Steer and reverse your car while keeping clear of nearby obstacles. The parking challenges depend on placing the vehicle accurately without hitting anything during the approach or final adjustment.

pages.title: Baby Room Designers
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate children's rooms in Baby Room Designers. Compare furniture and decoration suggestions, then choose pieces to put together each room. Help the designer coordinate the available options into finished interiors for the girls.

pages.title: Princess Winter Fashion
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Join two princesses on a seasonal shopping trip in Princess Winter Fashion. Explore their winter fashion choices in Paris and help select their looks. Coordinate the available items as the characters prepare their wardrobes for the colder weather.

pages.title: Paintball Racers
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Drive, jump, and shoot through Paintball Racers. Compete on hilly tracks while collecting coins and firing paintballs at rivals. Use turbo for speed and time your jumps around the terrain as you work toward winning races and completing challenges.

pages.title: Climb Up
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Scale an endless building with a climbing robot in Climb Up. Move its arms quickly to continue ascending while avoiding lasers, mines, and other obstacles. The aim is to reach a higher point before a hazard ends the climb.

pages.title: Skid Cars
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Avoid the other drivers in Skid Cars. Keep watching the rival vehicles and adjust your driving to prevent a crash. The challenge centers on reacting to their movement quickly enough to preserve your car's run.

pages.title: Sisters Cakes Battle
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose a sister to support in Sisters Cakes Battle and help her prepare a cake for a cooking contest. Follow the recipe activity with your selected competitor. The game focuses on making the dessert she will bring to the sisters' baking challenge.

pages.title: Justin and Selena Back Together
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a celebrity couple for fictional outings in Justin and Selena Back Together. Choose casual clothes for a park visit or more elaborate outfits for parties and red-carpet events. Coordinate both characters so their looks suit the selected occasion.

pages.title: Car Crush
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Keep your car clear of rivals in Car Crush. Use one-touch controls to avoid collisions, earn money, and push your score higher. A selection of cars gives you additional vehicles to choose as you work on improving your personal record.

pages.title: Halloween Pumpkin Decor
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a seasonal decoration in Halloween Pumpkin Decor. Help a young princess customize a pumpkin for the holiday. Select from the available decorative choices and combine them into a finished design for her Halloween celebration.

pages.title: Shopping Mall Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two royal shoppers choose outfits in Shopping Mall Princess. Visit each character's preferred store and compare dresses, shoes, and handbags. Put together a separate look for each princess as you work through their shopping day.
